name: org_graph_add_member
description: Place a person in a live unit of the Org Graph, from effective_on (today by default), with an optional role and allocation (greater than 0, at most 1). A person can be in several units. A unit an HRIS supplies takes only people that HRIS doesn't hold; place the others in the HRIS. Someone already in the unit is refused.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id
